question: Azzayt brand parent company
markdown:
Azzayt operates as an independent family-owned group of businesses rather than a subsidiary of a larger multinational conglomerate
. It was founded in 1988 by the Rodríguez family in Spain, and is structured corporately under
Azzayt Agroalimentaria S.L.U.
